notes: Item 19 is present and discloses multiple financial performance representations for Charles Schwab Franchise Branches. The FDD covers: (1) Adjusted ROCA (Revenue on Client Assets) for 2023, 2024, 2025 for all franchise branches — expressed in basis points and average client account balances; (2) Revenue Rates by asset category (Table 2) which are illustrative rate ranges based on historical data, not outlet-level revenue actuals, and therefore not extracted as individual performance records; (3) Revenue from non-variable annuities, insurance, referral fees, and financial plans (Table 3) which are rate ranges and not outlet-level actuals, excluded per ground rules; (4) Net New Assets (Tables 4a, 4b, 4c) — full distribution statistics extracted; (5) End-of-Period Total Assets (Tables 5a, 5b, 5c) — full distribution statistics extracted; (6) NTF Net New Assets (Tables 6a, 6b, 6c) — full distribution statistics extracted. All dollar values in asset/NNA tables represent assets under management or net asset flows, not revenue or profit — classified as metric_name='other'. The Adjusted ROCA is a rate metric (basis points), not a dollar revenue figure. Table 2 revenue rates and Table 3 commission ranges were excluded as they are illustrative rate ranges, not outlet-level performance actuals per Ground Rule 3. metric_scope set to 'franchisee' throughout as these are branch-level metrics. Confidence slightly reduced due to the highly specialized financial services franchise structure and the fact that standard revenue/profit metrics are not disclosed; the primary metrics are assets under management and ROCA rates.
